status: Research hypotheses and proposed controls; no combinations validated

items.hypothesis: Separately timed physical ice control and biological protection increase delayed functional-cell yield under matched handling.
items.current_support: Separate interventions supported; combination not established by the curated studies.
items.primary_readout: Delayed functional-cell yield relative to viable prefreeze input
items.falsifier: No reproducible combined benefit after accounting for donor/batch and toxicity

items.hypothesis: Maintained adhesion signaling contributes to protection beyond reduced extracellular ice injury.
items.current_support: CAMP FAK inhibition and CspB mTOR activation provide distinct pathway perturbations in different models; not interchangeable mechanisms.
items.primary_readout: Cell recovery and delayed function together with independent physical ice assay
items.falsifier: Biological effect disappears when physical injury and inhibitor toxicity are matched

items.hypothesis: CPA benefit depends on cell format, cluster size and preculture duration.
items.current_support: Supplement reports adverse cluster/age effects; aggregate study reports counting variability and no extra ROCK-pretreatment recovery benefit.
items.primary_readout: Absolute recovered functional cells with an auditable prefreeze denominator
items.falsifier: Apparent advantage is fully explained by counting or preculture differences

items.hypothesis: Early viability or identity markers alone systematically miss delayed cryopreservation effects.
items.current_support: Cardiomyocyte functional alterations and neuronal post-storage utility are separate domain-specific findings.
items.primary_readout: Lineage-specific functional potency and recovered-cell yield reported separately
items.falsifier: Early metrics prospectively predict delayed functional yield in held-out donors and batches
missing_inputs: author raw data for retrospective checks
